subject: Liventa: conditional log retention scope & SIG evidence pairing
messages:
From: Chris Turner <chris.turner@liventa.com>
To: Sofia Ivanova <sofia_ivanova@redwood.ai>
Cc: Alyssa Ng <alyssa@legal.liventa.com>
Date: Fri, 6 Nov 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Request: conditional log retention carveout for Liventa environment

Hi Sofia,

Thanks for taking this — quick background: as part of our upcoming SOC 2 Type II window we have a narrow scope request from our legal/compliance team. Liventa is asking if Redwood can offer a tenant-scoped reduction in raw session log retention for one production tenant (project-15) from the standard 180 days to 45 days, with a controlled exception to keep aggregated metrics for 365 days. They also asked for narrow evidence they can present to their auditor showing a) the policy change is in effect, b) deletions occurred, and c) controls preventing cross-tenant leakage.

Attached is the formal request (liventa-scope-exception-req.pdf) and a redacted sample of the purge audit for one session (redacted-purge-log-sample.csv). Requests from Alyssa (cc'ed) specifically call out SIG and CAIQ references — they want to map our evidence to SIG control families and a short narrative they can append to their auditor packet.

Can Redwood provide:
- A one-page narrative that maps what artifacts we will provide to SIG/CAIQ control IDs (e.g., LOG-6, LOG-7 equivalents)
- A confirmed list of deliverables (what files, what exports) and delivery ETA 
- Confirmation that this will be scoped to a single tenant and not alter default tenant retention globally

Would appreciate a quick reply with next steps — Liventa is aiming to have auditor-ready evidence by the week of Nov 23.

Thanks,
Chris

--
Chris Turner
Director, Compliance Programs | Liventa Health
chris.turner@liventa.com | +1-415-555-0159
From: Sofia Ivanova <sofia_ivanova@redwood.ai>
To: Chris Turner <chris.turner@liventa.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.ai>, Alyssa Ng <alyssa@legal.liventa.com>
Date: Fri, 6 Nov 2026 11:05:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Request: conditional log retention carveout for Liventa environment

Hi Chris — thanks for the clear ask and for the attachments. Looping in Marissa and Jonas from Security & Controls so they can scope the evidence and confirm isolation controls.

High-level response now, we'll follow up with a deliverables checklist by EOD Monday:

1) Scope and isolation: we can implement a tenant-scoped retention override for project-15 that shortens raw session logs to 45 days while preserving aggregated metrics and telemetry for 365 days. This change will be implemented as a tenant-level policy and will not change the global/default retention for other tenants.

2) Evidence we can provide:
  - Redacted purge audit logs (CSV) showing deletion timestamps and object ids (we'll redact PII before delivery)
  - Export of the retention policy config for the tenant (YAML/JSON) with the policy id and timestamps
  - A short narrative mapping deliverables to SIG/CAIQ control families (we'll draft this)
  - A role-based access control snapshot and routing rules demonstrating isolation

3) Timeline: target deliverables packet by Nov 18 (this gives us time for redaction and internal review) — earlier if possible.

Marissa/Jonas: can you confirm the list above and whether we need encryption key attestations or keystore screenshots for CAIQ mapping? Also, any objections to delivering an "evidence index" file that references the exact Drive files?

Chris/Alyssa: if you can confirm the canonical tenant id (project-15) and the auditor contact email (if they're expecting direct access), that will help speed things up.

Best,
Sofia

--
Sofia Ivanova
Senior Account Manager, Security & Compliance | Redwood Inference
sofia_ivanova@redwood.ai | +1-650-555-0234
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
To: Sofia Ivanova <sofia_ivanova@redwood.ai>
Cc: Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.ai>, Chris Turner <chris.turner@liventa.com>, Alyssa Ng <alyssa@legal.liventa.com>
Date: Sun, 8 Nov 2026 10:30:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Request: conditional log retention carveout for Liventa environment

Thanks Sofia — confirming the approach and adding details for the SIG/CAIQ mapping. Notes below are internal but I'm happy to include a redacted version in the evidence packet for Liventa.

What we'll produce (per deliverable):
- evidence-index.md (human-readable manifest mapping each artifact to SIG control IDs and CAIQ sections) — will include mappings for LOG-6 (log retention and backups), LOG-7 (log integrity), IAM-2 (role separation), and CRYPT-1 (key control references) where applicable.
- redacted-purge-log-sample.csv — we will run automated redaction to remove IPs and user identifiers; retained fields will be event_id, object_id (hashed), deletion_timestamp, actor_role, reason_code.
- retention-policy-export.json — includes policy id, scope: tenant:project-15, retention_seconds: 3888000 (45 days), created_by, created_at.
- rbac-snapshot.txt — list of RBAC roles with last-modified timestamps (redacted where appropriate).

Additional asks from our side:
- Please confirm whether Liventa requires signed attestations (e.g., a short letter on Redwood letterhead) or if a documented artifact index is sufficient for their auditor. Signed artifacts require legal review and could add ~5 business days.
- If they expect cross-checks against KMS/HSM operations, we will add a key-usage log extract and a short explanatory note.

ETA: internal review complete by Nov 12; delivery to Liventa Nov 13–18 depending on whether signatures are requested.

On a control point: this is scoped tenant-only in the config. Deletions are executed by a scheduled job and the deletion API writes to our purge-audit topic — we can export that topic for the tenant range. We'll ensure the export only contains hashed object ids.

Marissa

--
